items.quote: They spent longer understanding how we actually live than drawing. The plan that came back solved things we had not thought to ask for.
items.author: Client

items.quote: The site work was the part we were dreading. Having the same team that drew it also supervise it meant nothing got lost in translation.
items.author: Client

items.quote: Budget and programme were both tight. We were told what was possible within them, honestly, at the start rather than halfway through.
items.author: Client
